meanings.meaning: functional happy path with material gaps
tested, documented, and safe for the stated scope
robust evidence, negative/failure testing, thoughtful tradeoffs, and clear improvement path

dimensions.label: Security
dimensions.evidence_to_inspect: Least privilege, data handling, secrets, negative tests

dimensions.label: Resilience
dimensions.evidence_to_inspect: Fault behavior, recovery, backup/restore or rollback

dimensions.label: Operational quality
dimensions.evidence_to_inspect: Observability, runbook, clear ownership, actionable alerts

dimensions.label: Cost
dimensions.evidence_to_inspect: Estimates/limits, resource scope, cleanup proof, waste analysis

gate.text: Suggested gate: at least 20/28, no 0 in security or cost, all acceptance tests pass.
gate.note: A numerical score never overrides an unsafe deployment.

tracker.privacy_note: Record evidence in a private/local tracker if it would reveal account IDs, internal names, or security-sensitive details. Do not commit real cloud identifiers or raw incident logs to a public portfolio.
